text:
maya_growth: quick idea 1: run a 30-min micro-workshop + immediate credit bursts + curated prompt pack to drive trial activation. target: bump 7-day activation and shorten time-to-first-gen. who owns what?

eli_design: ill design a compact landing hero and 3 email templates. need a short tagline for the page.

tom_prod: instrumentation and routing ill take. suggest cohorts: control, small-burst (75 credits), large-burst (250 credits). include promptpack included vs opt-in arms.

zoe_csm: webinar should surface integration checkpoints for infra teams. also prep 2 troubleshooting snippets for onboarding.

maya_growth: tagline candidate: "Launch an LLM feature in a day 1: micro-workshop + prompts + credits" Feedback?

eli_design: clean. social copy (X): "Micro-workshop: ship an LLM proof-of-concept fast. Free prompt pack + credits. RSVP: <link> :zap:"

tom_prod: tagging: utm_campaign=microws_q3_promptpack, experiment=microws_pp_2023. events: reg, attend, credit_claimed, first_gen, activated_7d.

maya_growth: segmentation plan: randomize registrants into 4 cells; target n=200 per cell. run for 14 days post-reg to measure early retention.

zoe_csm: follow-up cadence suggestion: immediate email with prompt pack + redeem link; day2 nudge with example prompts; day6 invite to office hours.

tom_prod: routing pseudo: ```if credit_claimed -> add_tag:burst_redeemer -> enroll:faststart_onboard else -> enroll:nurture_track```

maya_growth: success criteria: +3pp in 7-day activation vs control, uplift in avg gens/week for redeemers. budget cap: $X per cohort (will calc).

notify-bot: Reminder set: landing goes live Thu 08:00 UTC. Auto-reminder for registrants 12h before event.

eli_design: timeline ok. ill drop hero concepts by Tue.

tom_prod: ill prep analytics queries and sample-size calc by EOD tomorrow.

maya_growth: great. actions: eli - visual + copy; tom - tracking + queries; zoe - onboarding notes; me - promo schedule + social. will create experiment doc and share link. :thumbsup:
